title: A Kitchen for the Songbook
author: Zephyrine Eastwick
blurb: Paloma Crane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
